product_identity: AI Revenue Recovery, with Control. Premium, professional fintech product.

theme.description: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth). 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action and indicate status.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Outfit' for all headings to provide a geometric, premium tech feel. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text and data tables for maximum legibility. All financial numbers and metrics MUST use tabular-nums utility to ensure vertical alignment in tables.

hierarchy.financial_metric_large: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-medium tracking-tight text-slate-900 tabular-nums

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Strict adherence to semantic colors is mandatory. Never use generic gradients. Do not mix pending/verified states. Never use pure black or pure gray; use Slate (blue-tinted gray).

surfaces.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-md), border-slate-300.
surfaces.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers. bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50 shadow-sm.
surfaces.grid_borders: Use for the data ingestion validation report and complex data tables. border-collapse with subtle border-slate-200 on cells.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 in grids.
layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B (High Density Grid). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6. KPI Cards: col-span-1. Main Chart: col-span-3. Funnel/Feed: col-span-1.
layouts.page_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out for buttons/links. transition-transform duration-300 ease-out for card hovers.
motion.data_loading: Use skeleton loaders matching the exact shape of the data. No spinning wheels for full page loads.
motion.decision_replay: Step-through animation must highlight the current active step with a high-contrast border and slight scale (scale-105) while dimming past steps.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio. Badges must have dark text on light backgrounds for readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='decision-replay-next-btn', data-testid='approve-case-btn').

components_instructions.badges: Strict usage of the semantic colors object. Always solid light background, 1px darker border, dark text. e.g., bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-200.
components_instructions.kpi_cards: Top-left alignment of text. Label overline. Large tabular metric. Bottom row for trend (+/- %). Never center-align.
components_instructions.tables: Left-align text, right-align financial numbers. Use border-b border-slate-100 between rows. Hover state on rows: bg-slate-50.
components_instructions.buttons: Primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800. Secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50. Action/Execute: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700.
components_instructions.charts: Use Recharts. Tooltips must show exact amounts and explicitly label the state (Expected vs Verified). Ensure colors map exactly to semantic_statuses.

dashboard.kpis: Display 6 cards: Revenue at Risk, Verified Gross Recovery, Verified Net Recovery, Active Cases, Recovery Rate, Exceptions.
dashboard.funnel: Horizontal or vertical flow chart showing Detected -> Eligible -> Evaluated -> Approved -> Executed -> Verifying -> Recovered. Connect with strict arrows.
dashboard.table: Filterable/searchable. Highlight 'Policy Result' and 'Outcome' with semantic badges.

case_detail.layout: 2-column layout. Left (2/3): AI Analysis, Action Comparison Table, Audit Trail. Right (1/3): Summary, Payment Timeline, Policy Result.
case_detail.decision_replay: Interactive sticky header or dedicated section with timeline nodes. Clicking a node changes the view below to show the system state at that exact millisecond.

data_ingestion.dropzone: Large dashed area (border-dashed border-2 border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 p-12 text-center).
data_ingestion.validation_report: Grid borders mode. Clear counts of total rows, valid, invalid, duplicates. High visual priority on 'Exceptions Queue'.

review_queue.action_bar: Sticky bottom bar or top bar for actions: Approve, Reject, Alternate Action, Mark Invalid. Require confirmation for irreversible actions.

webhook_simulator.visuals: Must be visually distinct. Wrap the entire panel in a 2px violet border (border-violet-500) with a 'SIMULATED ENVIRONMENT' banner at the top. Test events must use violet badges.

login.layout: Split screen. Left: Abstract architectural background image with brand overlay. Right: Clean white login panel centered, Google social login button prominent.

login_background.description: Minimal white concrete architectural wall for login background to evoke structure, security, and modernity.

user_avatar.description: Professional finance analyst portrait for the authenticated user avatar.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics. Make the frontend distinctive and highly professional.
NEVER use generic centered layouts for data or metrics. Align left for text/labels, align right for financial numbers.
CREATE depth using layered elements (z-index) and subtle borders, NOT heavy shadows or 3D effects. This is a high-end fintech tool, keep it flat and crisp.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add explicit transitions for specific properties.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react exclusively.
Ensure the distinction between REAL, SIMULATED, VERIFIED, and UNVERIFIED data is impossible to miss. Your design must structurally enforce this honesty.
Use 2x more spacing between distinct logical sections to let the heavy data breathe.
All interactive elements and key text MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
3d_libraries_and_motion: Not required for core dashboard functionality. Focus heavily on Recharts for 2D data visualization and Framer Motion for the Decision Replay timeline transitions.
